content.what_it_is: A complete FUNWAVE run log for a 500-by-120 flat-depth, four-process vessel-propeller case with two pressure vessels, sediment and propeller-effect parameters, outputs through roughly 79 seconds of an 80-second target, and normal termination after 73.38 seconds wall time.
entities: Parallel decomposition and grid at lines 5-12
Time and still-water settings at lines 14-24
Wavemaker, periodic boundary, and sponge settings at lines 26-43
Obstacle and physics settings at lines 45-58
Numerics and breaking settings at lines 60-75
Two vessel and propeller definitions at lines 130-158
Sediment defaults and parameters at lines 159-183
Initial statistics and vessel trajectory reads at lines 184-195
Periodic statistics and field outputs at lines 196-407
Run duration and normal termination at lines 408-409
